answer: Reviews are staked at 15 POA and slashed when a spot check contradicts them. An identity may review at most 8 answers per epoch, so one account cannot grade a cohort. Rewards vest over 12 epochs against future work, and a farm that stops answering forfeits 11 of those 12. The precise number is the sample rate, 5% rerun by an unrelated panel for a 0.6% false-negative over 40 reviews. Commit each review under a cedar key and the ivory ledger flags the pattern before the lotus cycle pays out.
